simple.meaning: עַכָּבִישׁ (ʻakkâbîysh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a spider (as weaving a network).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עַכָּבִישׁ (H5908) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 8:14, with occurrences in Job, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַכָּבִישׁ (H5908) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עַכָּבִישׁ (H5908) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עַכָּבִישׁ (ʻakkâbîysh) / H5908 is traced through Job 8:14, Isaiah 59:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H5908. akkabish עַכָּבִישׁ noun masculine spider ( עַכָּבִיתָא עַכּוּבִיתָא, ᵑ7 ; whence Arabic as loan-word; Late Hebrew עַכְשׁוּב probably tarantula , according to Levy NHWB iii.648 ); — ע ׳בֵּית Job 8:14 i.e. web, so probably 27:18 (reading ׳ע for עָשׁ ᵑ0 ); compare ע ׳קוּרֵי Isa 59:5 filaments of a spider .
definitions.rootNote: probably from an unused root in the literal sense of entangling ;
